methodologyNotes: Covers consumer smart and RGB LED strip light kits sold as a complete ready-to-install package (strip + controller + power supply) at a published US price. Excludes bare LED tape sold by the reel without a controller, under-cabinet puck lights, and neon rope/flex tube products unless marketed as a strip kit. Price is US MSRP or typical retail in USD for the base/starter kit at the stated length. lengthMeters is the total illuminated strip length included in the base kit, in meters. ledType is an enum describing color capability: 'rgb' (single-zone color), 'rgbic' (addressable multi-zone color), 'rgbwic' (addressable color plus dedicated white), 'rgbww' (color plus warm+cool white, single zone), 'tunable-white' (white only, variable temperature), or 'white' (fixed white). brightnessLumens is the maximum rated total luminous output of the kit at full brightness, in lumens. ledDensityPerMeter is the number of LEDs per meter, as a count. colorTempRangeKelvin is the tunable white range written as 'low-high' in Kelvin; null if the strip has no dedicated white channel. connectivity is an enum of the primary control radio: 'wifi', 'bluetooth', 'wifi-bluetooth', 'zigbee', 'thread', or 'matter'. ipRating is the IEC 60529 ingress-protection rating of the strip (e.g. 'IP20', 'IP44', 'IP65', 'IP67'). powerConsumptionWatts is the maximum power draw at full white, in watts. inputVoltage is the DC operating voltage of the strip, in volts. musicSync is a boolean for built-in music/sound reactivity (via app or on-device mic). warrantyMonths is the stated manufacturer warranty, in months.

Used the $149.99 MSRP for the 32.8ft base kit. Amazon US listing showed no USD featured offer (EUR/Germany locale), so price taken from the manufacturer page.
products.provenance: The Govee US product page confirmed this exact model (SKUs H61F2 6.56ft / H61F5 16.4ft / H61F6 32.8ft), the "$149.99" MSRP (shown as "$112.99 $149.99", $112.99 sale), the 2700-6500K white range, dual Wi-Fi/Bluetooth control (FAQ: "both Wi-Fi and/or Bluetooth"), and RGBWWIC (addressable IC + white) beads; the base kit documented here is the 32.8ft/10m H61F6 variant. The Amazon retailer page for the 32.8ft H61F6 corroborated model identity and supplied the electrical specs verbatim (Voltage 24 Volts, Wattage 72 watts), RGBWWIC color type, indoor "Not Water Resistant" build, and the integrated-mic Dynamic Music Mode. products.name: LIFX Z
products.priceNote: US price $89.99 per the MacRumors review (Nov 16, 2018): "The LIFX Z light strip ... can be purchased from the LIFX website for $89.99 or from Amazon.com"; described throughout as "a $90 light strip." The Amazon US "LIFX Z LED Strip Starter Kit" listing was "Currently unavailable" with no price shown, so it is not used for the price figure.
products.provenance: The archived LIFX US "Z LED Strip - Product Specifications" page (manufacturer) states the core electricals verbatim: colour temperature "2500K to 9000K", "17 Watts per 2 meters", "700 lumens per strip up to a maximum of 2800 lumens per power supply", Wi-Fi "802.11b,g,n" (no hub), and AC 100-240V mains input. The MacRumors review (dated Nov 16, 2018) confirms this exact model — "the LIFX Z, a $90 light strip", "6.6 feet" / "1400 lumens per two meters", "8 zones per strip, for a total of 16 zones", "connect directly to WiFi and thus don't require a bridge", and an in-app "Music Visualizer option that listens to ambient sound" — and gives the price "$89.99". Model identity and the RGB+W (dedicated white) basis for the rgbwic classification were cross-checked against the Amazon "LIFX Z LED Strip Starter Kit" listing (17 watts, Wi-Fi, "8 individually Addressable Color/white zones", "warm to cool whites") and Home Depot's "Multi-Color RGB+W" naming for the LIFX Z family.
